title: Meeting notes app with AI action items
prompt: I want an app for my meeting notes. I paste in the notes, give the meeting a title and hit Process. AI pulls out the action items, each with what needs doing, who owns it and the due date if one is mentioned. I see a list of meetings and can open one to see its notes and items. An All Open page shows every unfinished item across all meetings, with a filter by owner. I can tick an item done, edit it if the AI got it wrong, or delete it. Deleting a meeting deletes its items. If I process a meeting again, only replace items I haven't edited or ticked. Everything has to still be there when I come back. If the AI fails, show an error and keep my notes. My Anthropic key is set up. Make it and get it working.
